newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: V&N Holding to slash 1996 dividends.
newsitem.headline: V&N Holding to slash 1996 dividends.

text.p: Austrian radiator manufacturer Vogel & Noot Holding AG said on Friday pre-tax profit in the first nine months tumbled 80 percent to 16.1 million schillings and that it would pare its dividend payments for 1996.

In the first three quarters, group sales climbed to 3.06 billion from 2.64 billion in the year-ago period and for the full year, the company sees sales reaching four billion, up from 3.58 billion in 1995.
But the company said it expected pre-tax profit for the full year to come in below that posted last year.
The dividend would likely be cut to 10 schillings from 19 on ordinary shares, and to 13 schillings from 22.5 on preferred shares, the company said.
